name: Katie Dunwell

bio.statement: A City of Wilsonville notice dated September 22, 2025 says Dunwell informed the city manager of a resignation from the City Council effective immediately.
bio.excerpt: Katie Dunwell has informed City Manager Bryan Cosgrove that she is resigning from the Council, effective immediately.

source.publisher: City of Wilsonville, 'Katie Dunwell Resigns from City Council'
